caption:
EGGLESS VANILLA CUPCAKE
7 ingredients, under 30 minutes :) 

Ingredients: 
Dry
- 140 grams AP Flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- pinch, salt

Rest of the Ingredients:
- 120 ml milk + 1 tsp vinegar
- 60 grams of softened butter
- 100 grams of caster sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla essence

Method: 
- preheat your oven to 170 degrees C
- make butter milk with the milk and vinegar, set aside
- sift the dry ingredients together
- in a seperate bowl, cream the butter and sugar till it gets white in colour then add vanilla
- add flour mix in 3 batches altenating with the butter milk, Basically it goes like this
Flour - Buttermilk - Flour - Buttermilk - Flour
- DO NOT OVERMIX
- Divide the batter into a cupcake pan lined with cupcake liners. you should get 8 cupcakes. fill a little more then half way full
- Bake for 15 minutes else till a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. 
- take out of the pan, cook on a rack and front when ready :)
